info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Provide to students basic knowledges about energy, different types of energy, including conventional energies and renewable energies
The course provides the main design strategies applied to energy efficient buildings.
After this course, students can design sustainable buildings with low energy consumption and integrate renewable energies.
